name: UNIVERSITY OF SOUTH DAKOTA STADIUM - FOOTBALL / BASKETBALL

violations.description: General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary. Observed gloves changes without hand washing. Hands should be washed between glove changes.

Preventing contamination by employees. — --Employee's single-use gloves were not discarded after being damaged or soiled. Observed food employees touching clothing and did not change gloves they were wearing. Gloves should be changed after touching personal items.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Walk-in cooler shelves found dirty. These should be cleaned and maintained clean.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Shelving unit in the walk-in cooler was found dirty. This should be cleaned and maintained clean.
